item.title: We Played 'Magic: the Gathering’s Most Unhinged Set of All Time and It Was Pure Chaos
item.description: “My goal was that each card would be charming,” principal designer Gavin Verhey told Polygon at MagicCon. “You should see it and you’d be like, ‘That’s crazy. I’ve never seen that before.’ Or, ‘That’s so funny, made me smile.’”

item.title: GTA 6 Is Bigger Than Taylor Swift, Analysts Say
item.description: Taylor Swift is one of the biggest music artists in modern times. From 2023 to late 2024, the Eras Tour took her all over the world to play nearly 150 shows for millions of fans. It was a monumental moment in her career, and it earned $2 billion in ticket sales , becoming the highest-grossing tour of all time. Grand Theft Auto 6 grossed double that amount, in just four days.

item.title: Adam Driver and Steven Soderbergh Worked for Free on Their Star Wars Movie — Until Disney Killed It
item.description: One of the first rules I learned when I entered the job market was: never work for free. Adam Driver and Steven Soderbergh didn't care much about that rule, because they had been given such strong assurances that Disney would approve their Star Wars film, The Hunt for Ben Solo .

item.title: Scott Pilgrim Is Officially Coming to Fortnite
item.description: Anime style has been the main focus in Fortnite Treasure Hunters due to its crossover with One Piece . However, Epic Games is now changing lanes and bringing a beloved new IP into Fortnite . As confirmed by series creator Bryan Lee O'Malley, Scott Pilgrim is coming to Fortnite soon.

item.title: GTA 6 is Officially the Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
item.description: It's not exactly a secret that Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated game of the past decade. Thanks to the long wait and Rockstar Games' excellent hype campaign, it seems everyone with a PS5 (and a few Xbox owners, too) is playing GTA 6 now. But what does that translate to in terms of numbers? That's what the PlayStation Blog just revealed.

item.title: 10 Funniest ‘Far Side’ Comics Parodying Disney Charcters
item.description: From 1980 until 1995, no one was safe from the dark wit of Gary Larson , not even Mickey Mouse . For 15 years, while he was publishing his beloved single-panel comic strip The Far Side , Larson satirized just about everything, including popular culture. And while Disney didn’t own Marvel, Star Wars, the Muppets, and so many other brands back then, the company was still a huge target that Larson took aim at several times.

item.title: James Cameron’s Sci-Fi Sequel Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed from Netflix
item.description: In an action movie, there’s nothing worse than an underwhelming final battle. While Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings was one of the best post- Avengers: Endgame movies of the Marvel Cinematic Universe , its final battle became a disconnected CGI fest that was hard to follow. For Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Secret of the Ooze , the sequel’s fun energy was undermined when a mutated Shredder died after collapsing a dock onto himself without a fight ever even starting.

item.title: GTA 6's Best Easter Egg Is a Classic Tom Cruise Crime-Thriller You Can Stream For Free
item.description: One of Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s strangest random encounters occurs when you’re offering taxi services, and a man with a beard wearing a dark suit and sunglasses climbs into the backseat with a gun. This can happen if you’re playing as either Jason or Lucia, but both scenes play out the same way: The man wants you to run a red light, ignore phone calls, and drive him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach. He also sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, with a calm but forceful demeanor that seems almost sociopathic . Several clips of the sequence have already hit the internet, and to many people, it’s an obvious nod to Collateral , Michael Mann’s 2004 thriller about a hitman who takes a cab driver hostage.

item.title: 25 Years Later, GTA 3 Is Still the Most Fascinating Open-World Experiment
item.description: The artwork’s nothing to write home about, just a collage of pictures in red, blue, and green hues, featuring obscure faces, a police chopper, and a car up in flames. Your instinct is to just go with your gut; Silent Hill 2 is what you came here for, after all. But something’s telling you otherwise. Maybe it’s the store clerk going on about its open-world premise, or the name itself that strikes a chord within you. Whatever reason incites it, you make the ultimate decision. Little did you know, you’d be walking home with one of the greatest achievements in video game history.

item.title: GTA 6 Is So Unstoppable It's Even Made Nickelback Go Viral
item.description: It's still a debate whether Grand Theft Auto 6 has the best gaming soundtrack of 2026, but it certainly has the most soundtrack of 2026. Rockstar Games' latest open-world crime epic features more than 800 songs, most of which you'll hear on its 26 genre-themed radio stations . Of all this breadth of wild music, you'd figure the most popular song on the soundtrack would be something that had overlap with a Fast and Furious OST. But it turns out the single best song in the GTA 6 soundtrack is something by... Nickelback?
